toolCalls.args: {"command":"cd workspace; git rev-parse HEAD; git branch --show-current; git log --oneline -15"}

{"command":"Get-Content .\\workspace\\.git\\HEAD; Write-Host '--- branches ---'; Get-ChildItem .\\workspace\\.git\\refs\\heads -Recurse -File | ForEach-Object { \"{0} -> {1}\" -f $_.FullName.Replace('.\\workspace\\.git\\refs\\heads\\',''), (Get-Content $_.FullName) }; Write-Host '--- logs/HEAD (last 30) ---'; Get-Content .\\workspace\\.git\\logs\\HEAD -Tail 30"}
{"command":"Get-ChildItem .\\workspace -Force | Select-Object Mode,Name; Write-Host '--- root files ---'; Get-ChildItem .\\workspace -File | Select-Object Name,Length"}

{"command":"[Console]::OutputEncoding = [System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8
Write-Host '--- src/agents ---'; Get-ChildItem .\workspace\src\agents -Recurse -File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object Name,Length,LastWriteTime
Write-Host '--- src/cli ---'; Get-ChildItem .\workspace\src\cli -Recurse -File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object Name,Length,LastWriteTime
Write-Host '--- src/runtime ---'; Get-ChildItem .\workspace\src\runtime -Recurse -File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object FullName,LastWriteTime
Write-Host '--- src/surfaces ---'; Get-ChildItem .\workspace\src\surfaces -Recurse -File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object Name,LastWriteTime"}

{"command":"[Console]::OutputEncoding = [System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8
Get-ChildItem .\workspace\test -File | Select-Object Name,Length,LastWriteTime | Sort-Object Name
Write-Host '--- test grep for agent source tests ---'
Select-String -Path .\workspace\test\*.test.js -Pattern 'agent source|agentSource|Agent Source|agent-sources' -List -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object Path"}
